title: last night I got to revisit @Mexodus Musical for its first preview at...
transcript: You've probably never found this story in your history books or seen a show quite like this on stage. This is mexodus, one of the most captivating shows happening in new york city right now. Mexodus tells the little known history of the enslaved people who escaped not north on the underground railroad, but south to mexico, where slavery had already been abolished. I actually saw A mexican doing its last run at the minnetonka theater and i've been thinking about it ever since. It was one of my favourite theatre pieces of last year. it's back in new york for a limited run at the daryl roth theatre. And it truly cannot be missed, because while the story is incredibly interesting, it is these two performers that make the show so mesmerising. Ryan quijada and nygel D robinson, builds an entire score live on stage. They're playing instruments, using their voices, utilizing found objects, and then layering and looping it all. They create an incredibly vivid soundtrack that you don't just hear, but feel. They are two of the most talented people i've ever seen on stage and unbelievably creative. It's the perfect way to tell this timely, relevant and extremely powerful story. And it's absolutely one of those shows you must experience live. So if you're looking for something truly unique to see in new york right now, mexodus is it.
classificationReason: Creator attended first preview and provides detailed review of the show's content and historical subject matter
